info.title: Plasmic Universal API
info.description: Access Plasmic CMS collections to query, count, create, update, and delete content rows through the official Plasmic CMS REST API.

get.description: Counts draft items in Plasmic CMS.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: modelId
parameters.description: The Plasmic CMS model identifier to count in draft mode.

schema.description: The Plasmic CMS model identifier to count in draft mode.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A JSON-encoded Plasmic query object used to constrain the draft count.

schema.description: A JSON-encoded Plasmic query object used to constrain the draft count.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Optional locale tag such as ar-JO.

schema.description: Optional locale tag such as ar-JO.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

count.description: The number of draft rows matching the current query.
